steps.title: Create project folder structure
steps.details: Create folders: /models, /static, /templates, /data. Place framingham.csv inside /data.

steps.title: Create requirements.txt
steps.details: Include: flask, pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, imbalanced-learn, matplotlib, joblib

steps.title: Set up Python virtual environment
steps.details: Run: python -m venv venv and activate it. Install all packages from requirements.txt.

steps.title: Verify CSV file is accessible
steps.details: Confirm framingham.csv is inside /data and readable with pandas.

steps.title: Load framingham.csv
steps.details: Use pandas to load the CSV. Print shape and first 5 rows to verify.

steps.title: Handle missing values
steps.details: Fill missing values using mean imputation for numerical columns (glucose, BMI, heartRate, cigsPerDay, BPMeds, totChol, education).

steps.title: Define features (X) and target (y)
steps.details: X = all columns except TenYearCHD. y = TenYearCHD column.

steps.title: Handle class imbalance
steps.details: Apply SMOTE from imbalanced-learn on the training set only to balance the positive and negative CHD cases.

steps.title: Scale features using StandardScaler
steps.details: Fit StandardScaler on training data only. Transform both train and test sets. Save scaler as /models/scaler.pkl using joblib.

steps.title: Split data 80/20
steps.details: Use train_test_split with test_size=0.2 and random_state=42. Apply SMOTE after splitting, on training data only.

steps.title: Train Logistic Regression model
steps.details: Use sklearn LogisticRegression with max_iter=1000. Fit on SMOTE-balanced training data.

steps.title: Train Random Forest model
steps.details: Use sklearn RandomForestClassifier with n_estimators=100, random_state=42. Fit on SMOTE-balanced training data.

steps.title: Evaluate both models on test set
steps.details: Print Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC for both models. Use classification_report and roc_auc_score.

steps.title: Select best model
steps.details: Compare ROC-AUC scores. Save the better-performing model as /models/best_model.pkl. Also save a metadata file /models/model_info.json indicating which model was selected and its scores.

steps.title: Save scaler and model using joblib
steps.details: joblib.dump(scaler, 'models/scaler.pkl') and joblib.dump(best_model, 'models/best_model.pkl').

steps.title: Create app.py and initialize Flask
steps.details: Import Flask, joblib, numpy, pandas, json. Load best_model.pkl and scaler.pkl at app startup.

steps.title: Create route: GET / (home/input page)
steps.details: Renders templates/index.html — the patient data entry form.

steps.title: Create route: POST /predict
steps.details: Receives form data from index.html. Validates all fields (no empty, correct ranges). Scales input using loaded scaler. Runs model.predict() and model.predict_proba(). Returns result to templates/result.html.

steps.title: Create route: GET /recommendations
steps.details: Renders templates/recommendations.html with context: risk percentage, associated conditions, rule-based XAI factors, health tips. Data passed via Flask session or query parameters.

steps.title: Input validation logic
steps.details: Check: age (20-80), sysBP (80-250), diaBP (50-150), totChol (100-400), BMI (10-60), glucose (50-400), heartRate (40-150). Return error message to form if invalid.

steps.title: Rule-based XAI logic
steps.details: After prediction, evaluate each risk factor: if totChol > 240 flag 'High Cholesterol', if sysBP > 140 flag 'High Blood Pressure', if BMI > 30 flag 'Obesity', if glucose > 126 flag 'High Glucose', if currentSmoker == 1 flag 'Active Smoker', if diabetes == 1 flag 'Diabetes'. Return list of flagged factors.

steps.title: Disease association logic
steps.details: Based on flagged XAI factors, map to possible conditions: High BP → Hypertension, High Cholesterol → Atherosclerosis, High Glucose + Diabetes → Diabetic Heart Disease, Smoking → Coronary Heart Disease. Return as list.

steps.title: Create templates/index.html
steps.details: A clean, professional medical form. Fields: Age, Sex, Education, Current Smoker, Cigs Per Day, BP Meds, Prevalent Stroke, Prevalent Hyp, Diabetes, Total Cholesterol, Sys BP, Dia BP, BMI, Heart Rate, Glucose.

steps.title: Create static/css/style.css
steps.details: Style the form with a medical/health theme. Use a white card layout, blue/teal accent colors. Add proper spacing, labels, and input validation highlights.

steps.title: Add client-side validation (JS)
steps.details: Create static/js/main.js. Before form submit, validate all fields are filled and within range. Show inline error messages without page reload.

steps.title: Show loading spinner on predict click
steps.details: On Predict button click, show a spinner or loading indicator while the POST /predict request is being processed.

steps.title: Create templates/result.html
steps.details: Display: Risk Percentage (large, prominent), Risk Level label (Low / Moderate / High), color-coded banner (green/yellow/red), list of flagged XAI risk factors, list of associated conditions.

steps.title: Dynamic color coding based on risk level
steps.details: Risk < 20% → Green (Low Risk). Risk 20%-50% → Yellow (Moderate Risk). Risk > 50% → Red (High Risk). Change banner, percentage text, and border color dynamically using Jinja2 or JS.

steps.title: Emergency warning banner
steps.details: If risk > 70%, display a red emergency warning: 'High Cardiovascular Risk Detected — Immediate medical consultation is strongly recommended.'

steps.title: Navigation button to recommendations page
steps.details: Add a button: 'View Health Recommendations' that navigates to /recommendations, passing risk data via query parameters or session.

steps.title: Create templates/recommendations.html
steps.details: Display personalized health recommendations based on risk level and flagged conditions.

steps.title: Disease information section
steps.details: For each associated condition identified, show: what the disease is, its effects on organs, and prevention methods. Display as expandable cards or tabs.

steps.title: Low risk maintenance plan section
steps.details: If risk is low, show a Healthy Heart Maintenance Plan: regular exercise, balanced diet, no smoking/alcohol, annual checkups, stress management.

steps.title: Disclaimer section
steps.details: At the bottom of every result and recommendation page, display: 'This is an AI-generated cardiovascular risk assessment and not a final medical diagnosis. Please consult a licensed doctor for professional medical evaluation.'

steps.title: Back/Start Over button
steps.details: Add a button to return to the input form (index.html) to enter new patient data.

steps.title: Run train.py and confirm model files generated
steps.details: Check that /models/best_model.pkl, /models/scaler.pkl, and /models/model_info.json are created successfully.

steps.title: Test full prediction flow end-to-end
steps.details: Enter sample patient data on the form. Verify prediction result, XAI factors, associated conditions, and recommendations all display correctly.

steps.title: Test input validation
steps.details: Submit empty form, out-of-range values, and invalid inputs. Confirm error messages appear correctly and no crash occurs.

steps.title: Test edge cases
steps.details: Test with a very low-risk profile and a very high-risk profile. Confirm color coding, emergency banner, and recommendations respond correctly.

steps.title: Final UI review
steps.details: Check all 3 pages look clean and professional. Confirm no broken links, missing styles, or console errors.
